cases.title: 驾驶：上海行 (Static Baseline & Cold/Warm Prefill)
cases.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1>: Supplies the continuing source city geometry, road network, vehicle carrier, visibility, position, scale, motion, wheel movement, timing, occlusion and camera framing.
<Picture 1>: Pure environment appearance reference for Shanghai Lujiazui in clear daylight: silver-blue curtain-wall glazing, pale stone podiums, dry charcoal asphalt, white road markings and pale granite sidewalks. It supplies materials and illumination rather than a fixed camera or street layout.
<Subject 1>: Paired vehicle sheet <Picture 2> depicts one vehicle identity in front, left-profile and rear views. The upper row identifies the original pale-blue boxy sedan carrier; the lower row defines its metallic-blue Xiaomi SU7 Max appearance, black panoramic glazing, silver-and-black five-spoke wheels, red brake calipers and continuous red rear light bar.

summary:
[video editing] Transform the source Shanghai city into a realistic daylight Lujiazui driving environment, replacing the original sedan carrier with one metallic-blue Xiaomi SU7 Max while preserving the continuing source road geometry, vehicle motion and camera.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1>: partially_preserved - retain building masses, landmark silhouettes, road and junction topology, curb height, lane boundaries, vehicle screen scale, ground contact, visibility, occlusion and continuous camera movement; replace proxy surfaces and outline colors with realistic materials.
<Picture 1>: attribute_transfer - transfer glazing, masonry, asphalt, paving, daylight color and atmospheric depth while source geometry determines all spatial arrangements.
<Subject 1>: partially_preserved - retain the source vehicle carrier, placement, screen scale, ground contact and motion while replacing its exterior with the blue SU7 identity shown in the lower reference row.

detailed_description:
Clear pale-blue daylight illuminates Shanghai's modern office district with warm neutral sunlight, soft cool shadows and restrained distance haze. Existing tower volumes receive silver-blue reflective curtain walls, fine window grids, brushed metal mullions and pale stone podium cladding. Existing architectural entrances receive recessed glass and stone details within their original surfaces. The road network remains dry charcoal asphalt with fine aggregate, subtle tire wear and white markings following the source painted segments. Raised sidewalks and existing plazas receive pale granite slabs, narrow joints and modest weathering. Curb lines, road widths, intersections, building corners and open routes preserve their source geometry. Existing river surfaces, whenever visible in the source, receive muted blue-green rippled water and sky reflections within their original shoreline. Colored proxy outlines become ordinary material edges. Daylight remains consistent across the continuing drive, with surface reflections responding naturally to the source view.

Whenever the original pale-blue sedan carrier appears in <Video 1>, it is replaced by <Subject 1>, a metallic-blue Xiaomi SU7 Max with a smooth fastback body, black panoramic roof and glazing, flush door handles, a compact roof lidar unit, silver-and-black five-spoke wheels, red brake calipers, tapered headlamp housings, a continuous red rear halo light bar and black lower trim, fitted to the source vehicle's occupied space and grounded at its wheel contact points.

All visibility, placement, pose, scale, motion, timing, wheel movement, occlusion and camera/framing state is governed by the continuing <Video 1> source stream. The three columns depict one vehicle's identity rather than three instances; its visible face follows the source orientation. Source geometry governs turning, reversing, braking and any occlusion, while this appearance persists. The environment photograph supplies surface appearance only. Streets contain the entities present in the source. Reference-sheet layout, captions and comparison panels stay outside the scene; gameplay HUD remains the separate source overlay.

cases.title: 魂系战斗：Dark Horns (3->6 Refs Expansion Switch Miss vs Hit A/B)
cases.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1>: Supplies the continuing source geometry, carrier identities, visibility, motion, timing, poses, camera and framing.
<Picture 1>: Environment appearance reference for the descending exterior stairs, weathered Gothic gate masonry, amber braziers and a dense antique-gold fog curtain with dark ochre folds.
<Subject 1>: Paired front, left-profile and back sheet <Picture 2> has the actual pale player whitebox in the top row and the rendered target in the bottom row; the bottom row depicts one human Pleasant Goat hero: white curled hair, short brown horns, human face, blue scarf and gold bell, ivory clothing and a weathered indigo wool-collared cloak.
<Subject 2>: Paired front, edge and reverse weapon sheet <Picture 3> has the source whitebox sword in the top row and the rendered target in the bottom row; the bottom row depicts one broad two-handed steel greatsword with a thick slab blade, tapered point, blue leather grip, short curled sheep-horn bronze crossguard and compact bell-shaped pommel.

summary:
[video editing] Transform the source courtyard into Dark Horns, a weathered stone approach outside the ritual arena featuring a white-haired human sheep-horned swordsman. Cool gray outdoor haze and warm amber brazier light illuminate weathered characters and wet stone. <Video 1> retains all spatial and motion control.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1>: partially_preserved - retain arena topology, steps, doorways, circular floor, carrier scale, attachment points, timing, visibility and camera; replace grayscale surfaces with the target materials.
<Picture 1>: attribute_transfer - transfer surface materials, lighting family, layered decoration and atmospheric color while the source video supplies composition and traversable geometry.
<Subject 1>: partially_preserved - retain player proportions, cape carrier and movement while replacing armor appearance with the human hero design.
<Subject 2>: partially_preserved - retain hand attachment and strike timing while applying the broad greatsword design.

detailed_description:
Broad large dark-gray stone slabs with smooth worn faces, widely spaced mortar seams and restrained damp sheen preserve the descending steps and landing. Large masonry blocks and quiet stone wall faces carry simple worn column bands, sparse shallow arch-border carving and subtle soot stains. Surface detail remains low-frequency and softly weathered, matching the interior floor; sparse candles and small edge debris leave broad unbroken stone areas. Amber braziers and wall torches cast localized warm pools and subtle reflections on wet paving. Cold gray outdoor haze softens distant walls. A dense opaque antique-gold fog curtain fills the source doorway, with vertically drifting smoky strands, dark ochre and brown folds, and soft golden wisps rolling at the threshold. The fog obscures the room beyond while its extent, opening state and occlusion follow the source gate. Side dressing stays on existing parapets and walls, preserving the descending route and free walking clearance.

Whenever the smaller pale humanoid player carrier appears in <Video 1>, it is replaced by <Subject 1>, a lean realistic human swordsman with an expressive human face, white curled forelock, brown horns, blue neck scarf, gold bell and a frayed calf-length indigo cloak following the source cape motion.
Whenever the weapon attached to the player hand appears in <Video 1>, it is replaced by <Subject 2>, a broad thick worn steel greatsword with a tapered point, long blue leather grip, compact sheep-horn bronze guard and bell-shaped pommel, following the source attachment and blade trajectory.

All visibility, placement, pose, scale, motion, timing, occlusion, weapon swings and camera/framing state is governed by the continuing <Video 1> source stream. The upper row of each paired subject sheet identifies the source carrier; the lower row supplies its rendered appearance. The three columns are views of one identity, not additional instances or fixed poses. Gameplay UI remains the separate source overlay.

cases.title: 武侠格斗：功夫嘉豪 (Multi-Condition Prefill Plan & Cross-Segment Re-Prepare)
cases.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1>: Supplies the source carriers and all time-varying geometry, placement, scale, pose, motion, effects, timing, visibility, occlusion and camera/framing structure of the continuing game.
<Picture 1>: Empty environment appearance study of the seclusion clearing, supplying cool smoky dusk, dark damp earth and embedded stone, charred timber, amber firelight and subdued distant haze. Its overview composition is for art review; the live source supplies the camera and visible instances.
<Subject 1>: Paired sheet <Picture 2> identifies the same player swordsman in front, right and back views: the upper row is the actual source model, and the lower row supplies an adult East Asian man with weathered natural skin, tied charcoal-black hair, a frayed charcoal shoulder mantle and scarf, anatomical-left blackened iron shoulder armor, layered dark cloth and leather, muted oxblood waist fabric and worn dark boots.
<Subject 2>: Paired sheet <Picture 3> identifies the same straight sword in broad-front, thin-edge and reverse views: the upper row is the actual source sword; the lower row supplies dark black-red forged steel, deep burgundy metal planes, restrained worn bevels, a matte black wrapped grip and carved black-iron guard and pommel.
<Subject 3>: Paired six-view sheet <Picture 4> identifies one reusable timber-pyre design: the first two rows show actual source structure in front, right, back, left, top and bottom views; the last two rows show corresponding charred-wood appearance in the same order. These views describe one design shared by the three existing source frames. The structural sheet leaves the interior readable; separate source flame, smoke and spark carriers supply the live combustion.

summary:
[video editing] Render the source seclusion clearing as grounded dark Chinese wuxia at smoky dusk, with a weathered swordsman, a black-red straight sword and three charred timber pyres around an open central practice area, while the continuing source video controls gameplay, motion, visibility and framing.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1>: partially_preserved - retain the level traversable ground, three-frame arrangement, structural openings, source actor and weapon geometry, collision relationships, effects motion, timing and camera while replacing proxy appearance and materials.
<Picture 1>: attribute_transfer - transfer the earth and stone surface treatment, charcoal palette, warm local firelight and cool atmospheric haze; use source geometry and framing for the live scene.
<Subject 1>: partially_preserved - preserve the source player's body scale, animation, attachment points and silhouette relationships while supplying the lower-row face, hair, garments and worn materials.
<Subject 2>: partially_preserved - preserve source weapon length, grip contact, motion, visibility and scabbard relationship while supplying the lower-row black-red steel and dark ornamental fittings.
<Subject 3>: partially_preserved - preserve each source frame's footprint, inward-leaning posts, square rails, vertical-wall X braces, open interior and seven-plank roof while supplying charred wood grain, ash and ember fissures.

detailed_description:
The broad level clearing has dark compacted earth, embedded flattened broken stone, fine ash, shallow damp sheen and restrained reflections around the existing fire bases. Cool gray-brown dusk and diffuse smoke provide atmospheric depth, with low-contrast distance fading into haze. Orange and amber firelight illuminates nearby ground and the inward faces of the existing timber. Charcoal-black wood, scorched brown grain, splintered edges and subtle ember-red fissures remain readable in the shadows. The three existing structures surround a spacious, continuous central practice area; the environment image supplies appearance, and the source layout supplies the navigable space.

Whenever the source player swordsman appears in <Video 1>, it is rendered as <Subject 1>, with weathered East Asian facial features, tied dark hair, a charcoal scarf and frayed short mantle, left-shoulder black iron scales, layered dark cloth, worn leather and a muted oxblood waist accent. Whenever the source exposed straight sword appears in <Video 1>, it is rendered as <Subject 2>, with blackened steel planes carrying deep burgundy-red forged texture, narrow worn metallic edges, a dark wrapped grip and compact carved black-iron fittings. Whenever an existing red square-frustum timber frame appears in <Video 1>, it is rendered as an instance of <Subject 3>, with inward-leaning charred posts, square rails, vertical-wall diagonal braces and the same simple plank canopy. Source flame carriers become irregular orange-amber fire within the open frames; source smoke carriers become soft rolling charcoal-gray plumes, and source sparks become small warm embers following their source trajectories. The source scabbard retains its attachment and dark leather-covered appearance, with the blade's exposure governed by the source drawing and sheathing state. When the source drinking prop is visible, it has worn natural brown gourd skin and follows its source hand contact.

All visibility, placement, pose, scale, motion, timing, effects evolution, occlusion and camera/framing state is governed by the continuing <Video 1> source stream. Apply the pyre design only to its existing source instances; a view may contain any visible subset of the three. The empty scene study, static identity poses and six-view layouts serve as appearance references rather than scene contents, actor removal, additional instances or camera commands.

A few near-camera flakes are softly defocused; the distant dust remains fine and sparse. Firelight briefly warms their edges, distinct from the bright orange embers rising around the pyres. Source flame carriers become irregular orange-amber fire within the open frames; source smoke carriers become soft rolling charcoal-gray plumes, and source sparks become small warm embers following their source trajectories. The attached source scabbard has worn dark leather covering and restrained black-iron fittings.
